Quick heads-up from our side — Jill (procurement) tried to join the 11:00 demo and got a Join button missing + SSO block error. - I can spin up a temporary Zoom meeting (no org SSO) and send an .ics + short link within 10–15 minutes.

Thanks — diving in. Quick diagnostic notes for the record:
- The event was originally created by an automated account (model-onboard@redwood.com) and then re-assigned to a pool alias. That alias was partially deprovisioned during a calendar cleanup last month and its public-facing metadata lost the primary organizer field. GCal therefore shows a non-resolvable organizer value for outside domains.
- Workaround: change the event organizer to a live account (monica@redwood.com) and re-publish the invite. That will update organizer metadata and should remove the SSO gating for external guests.
- I will: (a) claim organizer in the GSuite console for this event, (b) re-publish the invite, and (c) post a short note to Synthaco IT confirming the change.

Monica — I'm going to hand the organizer to you and push the updated event to attendees. Rishi — the Zoom .ics you attached looks fine; match it to the reissued event and we should be good.

Karthik Iyer
Senior Ops Engineer, Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com
